name: QRadar MCP Server
description: Bridges LLMs with IBM QRadar SIEM by providing access to over 728 REST API endpoints through four intelligent tool definitions. It enables security analysts to interact with offenses, assets, and rules using natural language while maintaining high token efficiency.
